description: FREE coverage precheck for the MCP Version-Safety Check: state one official MCP reference server (mcp-server-git, mcp-server-fetch, @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem or @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything; the short names git, fetch, filesystem, everything also resolve) and the version you run, and learn whether the package is in the advisory dataset, how many advisories are on file for it, and how many affect your version. The verdict, the fixed version and the advisory detail are in the paid check. — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/mcp-version-safety/precheck.

package.description: The reference server package (canonical name or short name).

version.description: The version you run, exactly as installed (for example 2026.11.11 or 2.3.0).

name: mcp_version_precheck
